from pathlib import Path
p=Path('programs/task-6fdbd856.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set(); objects=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if color in (0,8) or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            q=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
              seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
        objects.append((color,cells))
    # slide objects rightward, rightmost objects first; 8s are fixed blockers
    objects.sort(key=lambda o:max(x for y,x in o[1]), reverse=True)
    occupied={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==8}
    for color,cells in objects:
      for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=0
    for color,cells in objects:
      shift=0
      while True:
        nxt=shift+1
        if any(x+nxt>=w or (y,x+nxt) in occupied for y,x in cells): break
        shift=nxt
      for y,x in cells:
        out[y][x+shift]=color; occupied.add((y,x+shift))
    return out
''')
